material_results: Reference Harness-RL release documents Base-vs-AW reproduction but does not expose a tracked BC/Forced-CHECK reproduction path.

A Lean verification scaffold already exposes the desired heterogeneous outer action ontology, but its progress/action controller is prompted/heuristic and learned progress/value control is future work.
BFS-Prover-V2 off-policy RL trains tactic selection, while hierarchical inference control remains a separate reasoning LLM planner.

OpenProver has a strict fixed TOML planner vocabulary but one planner step can be an ordered action bundle; legality is not one centralized hard mask, continuous budget is not inserted into the planner prompt, and recent state includes raw planner output.

Safe Fork/Restore/Merge after external or persistent effects requires durable action/call identity, authorization/progress, required-result obligations, and atomic rule epochs; proof-state rollback alone is not execution rollback.

termination.exact_next_action: Specialize C83 to the typed Lean action set by classifying pure-local versus effectful actions and deriving the minimum trusted execution record/guard for each; then continue the targeted search for a learned formal-proof outer progress/action selector and formalize canonical structural state plus exact legal masks and replay tests.
